y-m-59-11.title: Chirevo chagadziriswa zvizere nokungoti mhinduro mbiri dzawanikwa here?
y-m-59-11.goal: Ziva kuti mhinduro dzinogona kupera panguva yokushandura chirevo, uye utonge huwandu hwemhinduro nokuenzanisa nzira dzakasiyana dzisingashayi mhinduro mumhando.
y-m-59-11.material:
Unoda kutsvaga mhinduro dzechirevo sin x = sin 2x kuna 0 ≤ x ≤ 2π (migumo yose mbiri yakasanganisirwa, verenga x sedzakasiyana nhamba chaiyo). (Kuverenga: sine x yakaenzana sine 2x.) Jimin akagadzirisa nenzira iyi.

"Paradzanisa mativi ose mbiri ne sin x kuti uwane 1 = 2 cos x, saka cos x = 1/2. Kuna 0 ≤ x ≤ 2π, x ine cos x = 1/2 ndi π/3 ne 5π/3, saka pane mhinduro mbiri."

y-m-59-11.prereq.1: Kukosha negirafu dzemabasa e trigonometric (sin, cos kuna 0 ≤ x ≤ 2π)
y-m-59-11.prereq.2: Fomula ye double-angle sin 2x = 2 sin x cos x
y-m-59-11.s.s1.prompt: Data inoratidzwa rimwe panguva imwe. Nguva dzose, sarudza pfungwa yako pamusoro pemhinduro yaJimin.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.hint.0: Isa ruzivo rutsva rwechikamu chega chega zvakananga muchirevo chekutanga sin x = sin 2x.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.hint.1: Tsvaga kukosha mumhando umo nhamba yaunoparadzanisa nayo ingava 0.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.0.info: Mhinduro yaJimin ndiyo iri pamusoro. Kana ukaisa mhinduro mbiri π/3 ne 5π/3 muchirevo chekutanga, dzinoshanda chaizvo.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.0.ask: Unotonga sei mhedziso yaJimin 'pane mhinduro mbiri chaizvo'?
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.0.after: Takasimbisa kuti mhinduro mbiri dzinoshanda, asi sezvo mativi ose mbiri akaparadzanwa ne sin x, mukana wokuti mhinduro dzakapera haugari wasati waongororwa.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Zvakarurama. Akaparadzanisa akagadzirisa, uye mhinduro mbiri dzose dzinoshanda, saka pane mhinduro mbiri chaizvo
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wakafunga kuti kuti mhinduro mbiri dzinoshanda kwakasimbisa kunyange mhedziso 'uye hapana imwe'. Kutsvaga mhinduro dzinoshanda kwakasiyana nokutsvaga mhinduro dzose.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Pane mhinduro dzishoma pambiri. Imwe chete ndiyo yakarurama
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Zvakapiwa kuti mhinduro dzose mbiri dzinoshanda. Zvinopikisa ruzivo rwakapiwa.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Mhinduro dzakawanikwa dzakarurama, asi pangava nemhinduro dzakashayikwa, saka kutarisa kuri kudikanwa
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wakaparadzanisa mhinduro inoshanda ne 'kuwana mhinduro dzose'. Iyi ndiyo maitiro okutarisa kana paine chinochinja panguva yokushandura.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Hatigoni kuziva kunze kwokunge taverenga mapoinzi okusangana zvakananga pagirafu
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Wakaratidza nzira yokutarisa zvakananga pane kusimbirira kubva pamhinduro oga. Funga kana inogonawo kutariswa nenzira yealgebra.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.info: Ruzivo rutsva: kana ukaisa x = 0 muchirevo chekutanga, sin 0 = 0 uye sin 0 = 0, saka inoshanda. Kana ukaisa x = π, sin π = 0 uye sin 2π = 0, saka inoshanda.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.ask: Kutonga kwako kwemhinduro yaJimin kunochinja sei neruzivo urwu?
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.after: x = 0 ne x = π zvinosangana nechirevo chekutanga, saka dzimhinduro. Kuti uparadzanise mativi ose mbiri ne sin x, sin x ≠ 0 inodikanwa, asi kuparadzanisa hakubvumirwi pa x ine sin x = 0 (0, π, 2π), saka nyaya iyoyo inofanira kuongororwa zvakasiyana.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.o.a: x = 0 ne x = π zvinoshanda nokungoitika, saka hatifaniri kudzitora semhinduro
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Kana ichishanda kana yaiswa muchirevo chekutanga, mhinduro. Funga kana paine chiyero chokubvisa mhinduro sokungoitika.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ruzivo rutsva ndezvokuti pane mamwe mhinduro, kwete kuti mhinduro dzaJimin dzakanganisa.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Mhedziso yaJimin yakanganisa. Zvakanyanya kugoneka kuti mhinduro dzine sin x = 0 dzakapera pakuparadzanisa
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wakabatanidza kuti sei mhinduro dzingapera pakuparadzanisa. Wakagadzirisa kutonga kwako zvichibva paruzivo rutsva rwokuti wakatarisa nokuisa kukosha kunoshanda.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Kunyange nemhinduro itsva, mhedziso yaJimin ichiri yakarurama
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Hauna kuongorora kana ruzivo rutsva ruchizunza 'mbiri chaiyo'. Verenga zvakare kuti pane mhinduro dzingani.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.2.info: Ruzivo rutsva: sin x − sin 2x = sin x − 2 sin x cos x = sin x (1 − 2 cos x). Kuti iite 0, imwe ye sin x = 0 kana 1 − 2 cos x = 0 inofanira kushanda.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.2.ask: Equation iyi ine mhinduro dzingani pamwe chete kune 0 ≤ x ≤ 2π?
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.2.after: Kana sin x = 0, saka x = 0, π, 2π, uye kana cos x = 1/2, saka x = π/3, 5π/3. Hapana kukosha kunopindirana, saka pane 5 pamwe chete. (Kana chiyero chaiva 0 ≤ x < 2π, 2π yasiiwa, zvichipa 4.)
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Hauna kuverenga mhinduro dzenyaya sin x = 0, kana wakangoteedzera mhedziso yaJimin. Wana x ine sin x = 0 muchiyero.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Iyi inyaya umo migumo yechiyero 0 ne 2π yakaverengwa sepoinzi imwe. Basa iri rakati verenga x senhamba chaiyo dzakasiyana.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Pangava pawakaverenga mhinduro kaviri. Rondedzera mhinduro dzenyaya imwe neimwe muchiyero imwe neimwe uye uongorore kana pane kukosha kunopindirana.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Wakabatanidza mhinduro dzine sin x = 0 (0, π, 2π) nemhinduro dzine cos x = 1/2 (π/3, 5π/3). Wakapatsanura nyaya ukaverenga imwe neimwe wega.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.reflect: Pakutanga, wakatonga sei pawakaona 'mhinduro dzose mbiri dzinoshanda', uye chii chakachinja mushure mekuona ruzivo rutsva? 'Mhinduro dzakawanikwa dzakarurama' dzakasiyana sei ne 'mhinduro dzose dzakawanikwa'?

y-m-59-11.s.s2.o.e: Govanisa mativi ose maviri ne sin x uye ugadzirise, wobva waingira x = 0 chete semhinduro yakasiiwa
y-m-59-11.s.s2.r.e: Wakafuridzira mhinduro dzimwe dzakasiiwa chete. Wana x dzose muchiyero dzine sin x = 0.

y-m-59-08.title: Formula yehuwandu yakarurama chaizvo nekuti yakatarisa ne n = 1 here?
y-m-59-08.topic: Huwandu hwakashandisa properties dze sigma (chiratidzo chekuwedzera)
y-m-59-08.goal: Mumhinduro inoshandisa hunhu hwe sigma, tsvaga mutsetse wakabata zvisizvo huwandu hwezwi rokungogara riripo, paradzanisa kukosha (n = 1) apo chirevo chakanganisa chinongoratidzika chakarurama nekukosha kunoratidza kukanganisa, uye vandudza nzira yokutarisa.
y-m-59-08.material: Hayun akanyora kukosha kwa Σ_{k=1}^{n} (2k + 1) sechirevo che n. (Kuverenga: sigma, k kubva pa 1 kusvika pa n, 2k pamwe 1. Ndiko kuti, huwandu 3 + 5 + 7 + … + (2n + 1).) Pakupera kwemhinduro, Hayun akanyora, "Ndakaisa n = 1 uye yakaenzana ne 3, huwandu hwandakawana zvakananga, saka yakarurama."
y-m-59-08.thinking.1: Sarudza kukosha kwokutarisa (muenzaniso unopikisa) kunoratidza kukanganisa

Mitsetse 3 ne 4 inotakura kukanganisa komutsetse 2 sezvakaita. Kutarisa pamutsetse 5 kunongoitika kuva kwakarurama pa n = 1, saka hakuratidzi kukanganisa.

y-m-59-03.material:
Unoda kuziva ne logarithms kuti 2^100 ine madhijiti mangani. Usashandise calculator.

Chibvumirano: kuti integer N ine k madhijiti zvinoreva k − 1 ≤ log N < k. (log ndiyo common logarithm ine base 10.) Uye kukosha kwe log 2 kwakapiwa se 'kufanofungidzira kwakaitwa round' chete.

Verenga renji rinopiwa nekufanofungidzira seizvi. Muenzaniso: 'yakaitwa round kuimwe decimal place yekutanga, 0.3' zvinoreva kuti kukosha chaiko ndi0.25 kana kupfuura uye pasi pe0.35.

Ngatidzidzei nezve pH, inoratidza simba re acidity. Mubasa iri, tinobvumirana kuti mu dilute aqueous solution, hydrogen ion concentration [H⁺] (unit mol/L, 'moles per liter') inotarwa ne [H⁺] = 10^(−pH). (Kuverenga: 10 to the minus pH power)

Solution | pH | [H⁺] (mol/L)
A | 3 | 0.001
B | 4 | 0.0001
C | 6 | 0.000001

Donghyun akati, "pH ye C ikaita nguva 2 pH ye A, saka C ine acidity yakaderera nenguva 2 kupfuura A."

y-m-59-05.title: Kureba kweFerris wheel imwechete kunogona kunyorwa nema expressions maviri akasiyana here?
y-m-59-05.topic: Kugadzira model yezvinoitika zvinodzokororwa nema graphs e trigonometric functions
y-m-59-05.goal: Kana uchinyora kureba kunofamba nenguva dzakatarwa mu expression ye cosine-form, ongorora maitiro ekuti center, amplitude nekushandurwa zvinosarudzwa nemamiriro, uye ugadzire iwe pachako ma expressions maviri akasiyana (ane masimbi akasiyana) anogutsa mamiriro.
y-m-59-05.material:
Ferris wheel inotenderera nekumhanya kwakatsiga, kutenderera kumwe zvizere mumasekonzi 60. Poinzi yepasi i 2 m pamusoro pepasi uye poinzi yepamusoro i 30 m pamusoro pepasi. Ngatitii nguva apo mufambi anokwira i t = 0 masekonzi, apo mufambi ari papoinzi yepasi.

Gadzira model yekureba kwemufambi (yuniti m) se h(t) = D + A·cos(2π(t − c)/60). (Kuverenga: cosine ye 2 pi times t minus c over sixty) D i kureba kwepakati, A i nhamba inosarudza amplitude (inogona kuva negative), uye c i huwandu hwakafambiswa kurudyi (masekonzi). Ganhurira kuna 0 ≤ c < 60.

y-m-59-05.thinking.1: Wana ma expressions akasiyana anogutsa mamiriro ekutanga
y-m-59-05.thinking.2: Tsanangura kuti ma expressions akasiyana anoratidza kufamba kumwechete

y-m-59-05.prereq.2: Radian measure: kutenderera kumwe zvizere = 2π (kuverenga: 2 pi) radians
y-m-59-05.prereq.3: Mitengo ye cosine: cos 0 = 1, cos π = −1
y-m-59-05.s.s1.prompt: Zvinoitika sei kana ukasarudza D ne |A| kubva pakureba kudiki 2 nekureba kukuru 30?
y-m-59-05.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora kuti expression h(t) inova chii kana mutengo we cos wakakura zvikuru nekana wakadiki zvikuru.
y-m-59-05.s.s1.hint.1: Gadzirisa ma equations maviri pamwe chete kuwana D ne |A|.
y-m-59-05.s.s1.r.a: Wakatarisa maximum sepakati. Funga kuti pakati paizova kupi pakati pepoinzi yepamusoro nepoinzi yepasi.
y-m-59-05.s.s1.r.b: Wakatarisa minimum sepakati. Mutengo we cos unobva ku −1 kusvika ku 1, saka unofamba dhuri rimwechete kumusoro nepasi kubva ku D.
y-m-59-05.s.s1.r.c: Wakashandurana mabasa epakati neamplitude. Tarisa kana D + |A| ne D − |A| dzichiva 30 ne 2.
y-m-59-05.s.s1.r.d: Wakaisa pakati pakati pe maximum neminimum, uye amplitude sedhuri kubva pakati iyoyo kuenda kumucheto. Kana ukatarisa D + |A| ne D − |A|, anoenderana nemamiriro.
y-m-59-05.s.s1.explain: Maximum i D + |A| = 30 uye minimum i D − |A| = 2, saka D = 16 uye |A| = 14.
y-m-59-05.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira (A, D, c) mbiri dzakasiyana dzinoisa mufambi papoinzi yepasi (kureba 2 m) pa t = 0. (Period i masekonzi 60, 0 ≤ c < 60, uye ita c integer.)
y-m-59-05.s.s2.hint.0: Isa t = 0 mu expression uye unyore kuti mutengo uri mukati me cos unofanira kuva chii kuti h(0) ive 2.
y-m-59-05.s.s2.hint.1: Funga zvakaparadzana kana A i positive nekana A i negative.
y-m-59-05.s.s2.hint.2: Mushure mekusarudza c, isa t = 0 ne t = 30 uye utarise kana kureba kuri 2 ne 30.
y-m-59-05.s.s2.fail.c1: Sarudza D ne |A| zvakare kuti maximum 30 neminimum 2 zvese zvigutswe.
y-m-59-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Ita c integer kubva ku 0 kusvika asati asvika ku 60.
y-m-59-05.s.s2.fail.c3: Tarisa kana, kana ukaisa t = 0, mutengo we cos unopa kureba kwe 2 kuti kuenderane nesimbi ye A. Funga kuti mutengo uri mukati me cosine i 0 kana π rini.
y-m-59-05.s.s2.explain: Kana A = 14, saka pa t = 0 mukati me cos mufanira kuva −π (kana π) kuti uwane kureba 16 − 14 = 2, saka c = 30. Kana A = −14, saka pa t = 0 mukati me cos mufanira kuva 0 kuti uwane 16 − 14 = 2, saka c = 0. Ma expressions maviri h(t) = 16 + 14cos(2π(t − 30)/60) ne h(t) = 16 − 14cos(2πt/60) i kufamba kumwechete.
y-m-59-05.s.s2.because.prompt: Mumashoko 1 kana 2, nyora kuti sei ma expressions maviri anoratidza kufamba kweFerris wheel imwechete.

Kufambisa cosine ne hafu ye period (masekonzi 30) kwakafanana nekuchinja simbi yayo, saka ma expressions maviri i kufamba kumwechete.
y-m-59-05.s.s2.because.model.1: Ma expressions ese maviri anopa kureba 2 pa t = 0 uye kureba 30 pa t = 30, uye period i imwechetewo masekonzi 60. Rimwe rinochinja simbi uye rimwe rinotanga hafu yekutenderera gare gare, saka mhedzisiro i imwechete.
y-m-59-05.s.s3.prompt: Kana ukanyora Ferris wheel imwechete muchimiro che sine h(t) = 16 + 14·sin(2π(t − s)/60) (A = +14), s i chii kuti iri papoinzi yepasi pa t = 0? (0 ≤ s < 60)
y-m-59-05.s.s3.hint.0: Isa t = 0 uye unyore kuti mutengo uri mukati me sin unofanira kuva chii kuti kureba kuve 2.
y-m-59-05.s.s3.hint.1: Gadzirisa nequation kuwana s inopa mutengo uyo.
y-m-59-05.s.s3.r.a: Pa t = 0, sin 0 = 0, saka kureba i 16 (pakati). Funga kuti sin ine mutengo upi papoinzi yepasi.
y-m-59-05.s.s3.r.b: Wakasarudza kufambiswa kuti mutengo uri mukati me sin ive −π/2 pa t = 0. Pamutengo uyu sin = −1, saka kureba i 2.
y-m-59-05.s.s3.r.c: Wakatora kufambiswa kwakashandiswa muchimiro che cosine. Tarisa kuti sine ne cosine zvakasiyana ne chikamu chimwe pa 4 che period (masekonzi 15).
y-m-59-05.s.s3.r.d: Uku i kufambiswa kwechimiro che sine ne A = −14. Tarisa kana, kana A i +14, mutengo we sin pa t = 0 i −1.
y-m-59-05.s.s3.explain: Kuti kureba kuve 2 pa t = 0, mutengo uri mukati me sin unofanira kuva −π/2 (ndiko kuti, 2π(0 − s)/60 = −π/2). Saka s = 15. Sine yakasiyana ne cosine ne chikamu chimwe pa 4 che period (masekonzi 15), saka c = 30 muchimiro che cosine ne s = 15 muchimiro che sine i nhamba dzakasiyana.

y-m-59-10.material:
Unoda kugadzira mitsetse 10 yezvigaro mutiyeta diki. Isa zvigaro a pamutsetse wekutanga, uye pamutsetse wega wega uri shure, wedzera ne d zvigaro chaizvo (d inhamba yechisikigo). Mamiriro ndi aya:

· Zvigaro 300 zvose chaizvo
· Mutsetse wekutanga une zvigaro 5 kana kupfuura
· Mutsetse wapashure (wechi 10) une zvigaro 50 kana shoma

(a ne d zvose nhamba dzechisikigo. Huwandu hwezvigaro mumutsetse wega wega hunowedzera ne d kubva pamutsetse wekutanga kuenda kumutsetse wapashure.)
